about.story.p1: Iron Byte started in 2019 as a two-person studio with one rule: ship work we’d proudly put our names on. Word spread, clients stayed, and we grew into a distributed team of 20+ designers, engineers, and product thinkers across Europe and North America.
about.story.p2: Today we partner with startups and enterprises alike — from first prototypes to long-running platforms — always with the same focus: clear scope, honest timelines, and software that still makes sense years later.
about.values.1.title: Transparency first
about.values.1.body: No hidden costs, no scope creep surprises. We communicate openly at every stage of the project.
about.values.2.title: Craft over speed
about.values.2.body: We move fast — but never at the expense of quality. Clean code and good architecture save time long-term.
about.values.3.title: Partnership, not vendor
about.values.3.body: We treat your product like it's our own. Your success is the only metric that matters to us.

language_kit_desc:
Learn English: LanguageKit is a comprehensive English learning app for iPhone and iPad, designed to help users of all proficiency levels build fluency, vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation skills.The app combines a wide range of learning tools in one place — from an extensive dictionary and personalized lessons to interactive exercises, short stories, idioms, and tongue twisters.
 It also features an AI Tutor for real-time conversation practice and instant grammar corrections, pronunciation feedback, and a Listen and Write mode for developing listening comprehension.To keep learning engaging, LanguageKit includes several vocabulary-building games such as Hangman, Find the Pair, Find the Right Translation, Native to English, and Translate by Ear.
 Users can also create custom flashcard sets, take notes with NotesKit, and track their progress through an achievements system. Home and lock screen widgets help learners stay consistent with daily practice.The app supports 12 languages, making it accessible to a diverse, global audience. It's free to download with optional premium subscriptions, and is rated 4+ with a 5.0 rating on the App Store.
migrane_tracker_desc:
Migraine Tracker: Relief AI is a medical app for iPhone and iPad designed to help migraine sufferers log attacks, identify triggers, and generate clinical reports — all with minimal effort, even during a painful episode.
The app's core strength is its speed and simplicity: attacks can be logged in as little as 5 seconds, with large buttons and a dark-mode interface built specifically for light-sensitive moments. An AI-powered Detective Engine analyzes logged data over time to surface hidden trigger correlations — such as weather pressure changes, stress, or specific foods — turning chaotic symptoms into actionable patterns.
Key features include MIDAS Report generation (the official neurologist disability score, exportable as a signed PDF), hormonal cycle tracking with attack predictions for menstrual migraines, a Green Light Therapy mode backed by clinical research to soothe photophobia during attacks, and barometric pressure alerts to warn users before weather-related attacks strike. A Daily Regimen tool helps users stay on top of medications, hydration, and sleep routines.
The app also includes an interactive head map for pinpointing pain locations, exact attack timing, complete searchable attack history, and fully customizable trigger and relief lists. All data is stored privately on-device and never sold.
Available in 25 languages, it's suited for episodic, chronic, vestibular, cluster, and menstrual migraine sufferers. Free to download with optional premium subscriptions.
numis_ai_desc:
NumisAI: Coin Value Identifier is an AI-powered coin identification and appraisal app for iPhone and iPad, designed for both seasoned collectors and casual users who've stumbled upon an interesting coin.
The app's core feature is instant recognition — simply take a photo of any coin, and the AI analyzes portraits, inscriptions, and mint marks to identify it from a database of over 100,000 coin types. Coverage spans ancient coins like Roman denarii and Armenian tetradrachms all the way to modern US quarters and rare world coins, with a particular focus on USSR and Russian coins using the 2026 catalog.
Key features include AI-powered grading on the Sheldon scale based on visual wear assessment, real-time market valuations drawn from auction data, and a minting error detector for spotting rare and valuable mistakes. Users can organize their collection in an HD digital vault, generate professional appraisal certificates as PDF reports, and monitor live precious metal prices for gold, silver, and platinum.
The app is available in 20 languages, free to download with a 3-day trial, and rated 4+ on the App Store. A disclaimer notes that all valuations are estimates, and certified experts are recommended for insurance purposes.
symptom_tracker_desc:
Symptom Tracker: Illness Diary is a medical app for iPhone and iPad built specifically for people living with chronic and invisible illnesses. It replaces the exhausting mental effort of tracking symptoms in your head with a structured, intelligent diary that turns months of data into clear, actionable insights — ready to share with your doctor.
What sets the app apart is its Condition Profiles system: each illness gets its own isolated workspace, pre-loaded with the symptoms and triggers most relevant to that condition. Fibromyalgia data never mixes with migraine data, and switching between conditions takes a single tap. The free tier includes one condition profile; premium unlocks unlimited profiles — ideal for those managing multiple diagnoses simultaneously.
The app is designed around the reality of chronic illness — fatigue, brain fog, and low energy — so logging takes under 60 seconds, with large tap targets, smart auto-fill from Apple Health, and time-of-day logging (morning, afternoon, evening, night) to capture how a day truly unfolds. After 10 days of logging, on-device analytics surface trigger correlations and flare patterns that might have gone unnoticed for years.
Supported conditions include fibromyalgia, IBS, migraines, lupus, PMDD, POTS, EDS, ME/CFS, endometriosis, and arthritis, among others — or users can build a fully custom condition profile. Premium features also include doctor-ready PDF export, Apple Watch logging, full HealthKit sync, CSV export, and unlimited medication tracking.
All health data is encrypted, stored locally on-device, never sold, and never used for ads. Available in 16 languages, free to download with optional premium subscriptions.
vibe_kit_desc:
VibeKit: The Voice Journal is a lifestyle app for iPhone and iPad that reimagines journaling as a voice-first experience — designed for people who find typing their thoughts a chore but have plenty to say.
The core idea is simple: hit record, speak freely, and VibeKit automatically transcribes and saves your audio into a private, fully searchable diary. There's no blank page pressure, no formatting — just your voice, captured and organized. It's built for quick, spontaneous reflection, whether you're processing your day, venting, capturing a sudden idea, or just thinking out loud.
Beyond voice journaling, the app also serves as a daily inspiration hub. Users get access to curated daily quotes across 30+ categories — love, motivation, affirmations, success, and more — along with a private written diary for traditional journaling. Home and lock screen widgets keep daily quotes front and center, and entries can be customized with different fonts, sizes, and colors. Quotes can also be shared as images.
No data is collected by the developer, keeping your journal entirely private. Available in English, free to download with optional premium subscriptions.
